text_block_list.text:
One evening, while passing through the 
shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whaaa-?! That looks like so much fun~!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look who's here, Urara-chan! How about 
it, wanna try your luck at the raffle?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The lottery!! I wanna do it, I wanna try 
it~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's do the raffle, come on, 
please~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What's a... ticky? Do I need it for the 
raffle?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could that mean...! Are you talking 
about the ticket that lady gave me 
recently!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The lady at the candy shop stuck one to my 
lollipop and gave it to me as a bonus!
choice_data_list:
In that case, we can take on the 
challenge.

In that case, we can take on the 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's go spin it around!
choice_data_list: What prize are you aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hmm, I wonder what?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Going to a hot spring sounds fun, but I 
love hamburg steaks too, and carrots are 
great no matter how many there are!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Even if I lose, spinning the raffle wheel 
is super fun anyway! So anything's fine by 
me~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Come on, spin it faster! Round and round~♪

Prompted by a high-spirited Haru Urara, I 
gripped the lever with her and spun the 
raffle drum.
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sound was amazing! Hey, hey, 
let me hear it again~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-chan! It's the grand prize! A hot 
springs trip~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring!? We get to go to a hot 
spring~!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! We did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Hey, hey, when are we going? Are we 
going tomorrow?
choice_data_list: Tomorrow is a bit much, though...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Then when? The day after tomorrow, 
the day after that, or even further out~?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
How many times did the sky spin around 
today? I'm gonna do my best to chase after 
the sun!

"There'll be no end to this at this rate. 
That said, heading to the hot springs 
right now would be premature. To help turn 
this into motivation, I should..."
choice_data_list:
How about saving it as a reward for after 
the race?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
A rewaaard~~!! Only the super amazing kids 
who did their best get this!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I want a reward~! The hot springs will be 
my reward!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You see, Trainer, you should hold onto 
this ticket! A reward is most exciting 
right when you receive it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"So when you hand it over, make sure to do 
it confidently with a proud 'Ahem! Here 
you go!'"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so excited~♪

And so, I held onto the grand prize hot 
spring trip voucher until the right time 
came.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay, carrot hamburg steak! It looks so 
delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, this ain't just an ordinary hamburg 
steak, ya know? After all, it's "Special 
Grade"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I guarantee it'll blow every hamburg steak 
you've ever eaten right out of the water!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: *Gulp*...! Does that, does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If I eat that, is my tummy going to 
explode...?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because regular salisbury steaks are 
delicious too! So if it's gonna blow up... 
then it must be a bomb!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Mmm, I wonder if I can eat it~?!
choice_data_list:
...Do you have the courage to take on the 
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yes, there issss!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, mister! Trainer and I will eat 
every last bite, just watch us!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get what's going on, but 
I've never seen Urala-chan look so sharp 
before...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"I'm leaving this to you two...! You've 
gotta finish off that 'Special Hamburg 
Steak'!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

After returning to the academy, the two of 
us shared an explosively delicious 
hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! So many carrots!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
That might've been the prize that made 
Urara-chan the happiest.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, 'cause I loooove carrots!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's piled so high... Can I really 
finish all this by myself?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I can just give some to my 
friends!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, Teio-chan, Sei-chan, King-chan, 
Rice-chan, and then, and then――
choice_data_list:
Sounds like there are a lot of girls you 
want to invite, huh.

Sounds like there are a lot of girls you 
want to invite, huh.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I have lots and lots of friends!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, I want all my friends to eat the 
shopping district's delicious carrots!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Auntie
text_block_list.text: Ugh, what a good girl you are, Urara-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh, the greengrocer lady?!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Auntie
text_block_list.text:
"That carrot is from my shop! I'll throw 
in a little extra on the side, apart from 
the raffle, so make sure you drop by the 
greengrocer's...!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Really~? Thank youuu♪"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, now we can have a carrot party with 
everyone at the academy!

It didn't quite go that far, but along 
with the bonus carrots, I headed home 
carrying a huge haul of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay, such shiny carrots! Thank you, 
mister!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd be this happy over just 
one... It warms my heart.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just one, a carrot is still a 
carrot! It's super tasty and packed with 
nutrients♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's split it in half! Which do 
you want, the head or the thin side?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really!? Then, I'll take the head—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Nope! On second thought, I'll give the 
head part to you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Because the head has way more to eat! So 
I'm giving it to you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan... What a pure-hearted girl she 
is... *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why is that mister crying?!

After comforting the vendor, Haru Urara 
kindly offered me the head piece—and I 
savored its heartwarming sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aw man, just tissues~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Still, spinning it was super fun! Thank 
you, mister!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Urara-chan, there's nothing we can 
do about this one.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it! We get to use as 
many tissues as we want anyway!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then, if you gather a bunch of tissues 
and squeeze them tightly together...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And you get a carrot!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"It's pure white, totally not like a 
carrot! 'Cause carrots are orange, and..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...I really wanted to eat some carrots, 
though~.

Haru Urara seemed to lose a tiny bit of 
her energy...
